summary: Diff scopes events/tasks React Query keys by principal plus a per-login "sessionFingerprint", clears the query cache on logout, and hardens the encryption Zustand store updates for isUnlocking/reset. However, there is no evidence that the backend actor creation/react-query key/refetch behavior itself was updated to guarantee actor re-creation/re-initialization on Internet Identity session changes (REQ-1).

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure the backend actor is reliably recreated/refetched whenever the Internet Identity session changes (even for the same principal), updating the actor React Query cache key/refetch behavior so `_initializeAccessControlWithSecret(...)` runs for the new session and subsequent calls do not trap as unauthorized/stale-session.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows changes to events/tasks query keys and cache clearing on logout, but does not show any modifications to the actor hook/caching (e.g., `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`) or any logic that forces actor re-creation/re-initialization on identity/session changes. Without actor-side changes, it’s unclear that `_initializeAccessControlWithSecret(...)` will reliably run for the new session.

hallucinated_features.description: Added/modified URL parameter/sessionStorage utilities unrelated to the re-sign-in events/tasks loading regression.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest focuses on actor/session invalidation, React Query scoping for calendar data, and encryption unlock state handling. The URL params utility changes are not referenced by any requirement.

hallucinated_features.description: UI/branding changes in the Shell footer (copyright year, external link) not directly tied to fixing the re-sign-in loading regression.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by any REQ; could be incidental but is not part of the specified fix scope.
